o.text: From Russian сериа́л (seriál), from English serial.
From Arabic جِنْسِيّ (jinsiyy). By surface analysis, cins + -i.
Borrowed from Classical Persian هَمْکَار (hamkār). By surface analysis, həm- + kar.
Likely from Proto-Turkic *sï̄rïk (“pole; rod”). Compare Azerbaijani sırıq (“duvet stitch”), dialectally also "a pole to shake/knock the nuts from the tree"
